title: EPICS 12 – Health Services Research with routine data on Emergency and Acute Medicine
summary: The primary objective of this project is to assess the usability of and analyze routine data from the emergency department for the purpose of health services research in emergency and acute care medicine.

interventions.name:
All emergency department patients during the treatment years 2015–2025.
Primary: Data from electronic health records will be assessed for their suitability for use in health services research analyses.
Secondary: •    Determining the frequency of acute, less acute, and preventable emergency depart

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
all patients 18 years and older who were treated at one of the participating emergency departments during the calendar years 2015–2025 (all three Charité locations)
Exclusion criteria:
underage
